{{Quote|They're everywhere! I can't—|Tubbs's final words|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
'''Jaycris Tubbs'''<ref name="TLJ-TVD" /> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[pilot]] in the [[Resistance]] during the [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation of D'Qar]]. During the opening stages of the battle, he was one of the first [[Resistance pilot]]s to be shot down, when his [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] was hit by [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]] fire.<ref name="Episode VIII" /> Prior to his [[death]], Tubbs had always been keen to mentor new fighter jocks.<ref name="TLJ Junior novel">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> Tubbs had at least three children.<ref name="TLJ-TVD" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Jaycris-Tubbs-helmet-TLJVD.png|thumb|right|200px|Tubbs' flight helmet]]
As a pilot of a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="Episode VIII" /> Jaycris Tubbs wore an [[Color|interstellar-orange]] [[flight suit]] that had a [[utility belt]], emergency [[oxygen]] tube, and an equipment pocket. The suit was further covered in a white [[Flak vest|flight vest]] and was accompanied by a gray [[Guidenhauser]] [[flight harness]], a white [[FreiTek Incorporated|FreiTek]] [[life support]] unit, and black [[glove]]s and [[boot]]s. He also wore a red [[flight helmet]] that bore a yellow [[Rebel Alliance starbird]] and had the names of his children stencilled on it in [[Aurebesh]], that translated to 'Phi', 'Ted' and 'Stella'.<ref name="TLJ-TVD" />
